503523.Description: [DON!! x1] [Opponent's Turn] If you have 2 or less Life cards, this Leader gains +1000 power.

503538.Description: [Once Per Turn] If this Character would be K.O.'d, you may trash 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards instead.

503654.Description:
[DON!! x1] This Character gains [Double Attack]. (This card deals 2 damage.)
[On K.O.] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

504455.Description: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Play up to 1 yellow [Land of Wano] type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand.

504457.Description: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less and add this card to your hand.

504458.Description:
[Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +4000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, add up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 3 or less to the top or bottom of the owner's Life cards face-up.
[Trigger] Draw 1 card.

504459.Description:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Block] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: This Character gains +4000 power during this battle.

504460.Description: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 1 or less and add this card to your hand.

504461.Description: [When Attacking] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: This Character gains +2000 power until the start of your next turn.

504463.Description:
[Counter] If you have 2 or less Life cards, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards -3000 power during this turn.
[Trigger] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

504465.Description: [DON!! x1] If you have 2 or less Life cards, this Character cannot be K.O.'d in battle.
